description: A standing track to build the weekly copy changes that PR sends for the www-reading-advantage pages. PR owns the claims and the copy. Monorepo owns the build. Each weekly batch is one phase and one branch from master, with tests, gates, a live approval page, and a merge after Daniel passes.
owner_chain: PM orchestrator (sends the weekly entries; takes the out-of-scope requests back to PR)
Monorepo orchestrator (track owner; build, review, merge to local master)
requested_by: Daniel, 2026-10-26, tracks page row E8: "This needs to be continuous. Help me think of how to just have changes go to PR, and then PR plans changes to the www pages."
pm_reply: PR keeps one www change list in its repository and adds each changed fact with the new copy. In my Monday pass I send the new entries to Monorepo. One standing Monorepo track builds them. You check the changed pages on one approval page each week; then your team deploys.
constraints: Records only. This opening writes no app code, no test and no build.
No push and no deploy. The push to origin/master is Daniel's gate.
Pathspec commits only. No git add -A, no git commit -a, no stash, no reset.
Monorepo never writes in PR's repository.
deviation_notes: Opened 2026-10-27 by the Monorepo orchestrator as a standing track with no end date. It replaces the two July www tracks, archived at commit b7745061f.
